open_points.subject: INV-11 ownership
open_points.text:
`deliverer_api` owns INV-11 because every refusal answer is built by its `refusal_answer`: a refusal carries
only its code and a fixed message. `photo_delivery` supplies path-free results, and no module holds a client for any
outbound call.
open_points.question: Which module owns and enforces each part of INV-11—holding no Portal credential, never calling the Portal, and returning no server path—given that `deliverer_api` can control answers but cannot control other modules' credentials or outbound clients?
options: Split INV-11 and assign response secrecy to `deliverer_api`, credential loading to `deliverer_service`, and outbound-dependency exclusion to an explicitly named module or build boundary
Name one module with authority over all three guarantees and define how it enforces them
Declare the dependency/build specification as the owner of the no-client and no-credential guarantees while `deliverer_api` owns only path-free answers
open_points.default_guess: Split INV-11: keep answer secrecy with `deliverer_api`, assign credential configuration to `deliverer_service`, and make the build/dependency boundary explicitly own the absence of Portal clients and outbound HTTP dependencies.
